text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
――Aah... nice... I can feel the heat all 
the way to my fingertips...
choice_data_list: Are you feeling unwell, by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Don't be ridiculous! I'm just fired 
up for a serious showdown!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I won't ever show you such a pathetic side 
of myself again, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna prove it starting right now!!!
